name: Coffee Roaster (Craft)
tagline: A warm, working storefront for a craft coffee roaster.
description: A complete, working shop for a small-batch coffee roaster: a real catalogue of single-origin bags, blends, decaf, brew gear and a flexible subscription, with categories, collections, a bespoke coffee-shop PDP and a full merchandised home page. Warm roastery theme — cream paper, deep coffee-brown, a terracotta accent. Shipped as Cairn Coffee Roasters.
